11/S0.subgoal: Outline the lecture scope and introduce the factors related to the external content of cyber sickness.

11/S1.subgoal: Explain how visual motion, vection, and angular velocity influence the onset and severity of cyber sickness.

11/S2.subgoal: Describe how controlling motion and choosing transition methods affects cybersickness.

11/S3.subgoal: Explain how field of view (FOV) impacts user immersion and cyber sickness susceptibility.

11/S4.subgoal: Describe how the type, genre, geometry, and weather of virtual content influence cyber sickness.

11/S5.subgoal: Explain how the duration of exposure and the visual complexity of the environment contribute to cyber sickness.

11/S6.subgoal: Identify the three core elements (input, process, and output) of cyber sickness evaluation.

11/S7.subgoal: Describe how subjective, questionnaire-based methods are used to measure cyber sickness susceptibility.

11/S8.subgoal: List and explain the use of physiological, behavioral, and content-based inputs for measuring cyber sickness.

11/S9.subgoal: Compare manual evaluation techniques with automated and machine learning-based approaches, including transparent models.

11/S10.subgoal: Review the main causes and evaluation methods used to assess cyber sickness.
